info.title: Iriks-IT API
info.description:
The official API for [Iriks-IT](https://iriks-it.nl). Powering tools, collections, and mischief since Sam knocked the first server off the desk.

> *"Why did Sam sit on the API server? To keep an eye on the mouse."*

All authenticated endpoints require a Bearer token obtained via `/auth/login`. Tokens expire after **24 hours** — roughly the time it takes Silvia to forgive you for waking her up.

servers.description: Production — where Sam and Silvia live

tags.name: account
tags.description: Purr-fectly secure account management. Sam and Silvia got in, so can you. Email verification required — no exceptions, not even for cats.

get.description:
Returns geolocation, ASN, proxy detection, and AbuseIPDB threat intelligence for an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Sam sniffs every packet — you get structured JSON.

Requires the `ip.lookup` permission scope on your token.

**Caching:** AbuseIPDB results are cached for 14 days per IP to stay well within rate limits. Fresh data is fetched automatically when the cache expires.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up. Sam's current IP is classified.

200.description: IP data retrieved successfully. Sam sniffed it and found no suspicious treats.

reports.comment: Sam detected suspicious SSH traffic from this IP at 3 AM. He woke up the admin by sitting on the keyboard.
Silvia noticed this IP sniffing her ports. She hissed at it and reported it immediately.

location.description: Geolocation data from ip2location. Null if the IP is not in the database.

threat.description: Computed threat assessment. Score ≥ 50 or a known threat category means `is_threat: true`. Sam uses his nose; we use math.

abuseipdb.description: AbuseIPDB threat data. Null if no API keys are configured or the lookup is unavailable. Results are cached for 14 days — Silvia keeps meticulous records.

abuse_confidence_score.description: 0–100 confidence that this IP is abusive. Sam trusts anything above 50.

reports.description: Up to 50 most recent reports. History is accumulated across checks — Silvia never forgets.
